Control_Statement: Ensure data resources are not publicly exposed
Control_Description: Resources containing organizational data must not be accessible to unauthenticated or anonymous identities

Control_Statement: Ensure data versioning and recovery is enabled
Control_Description: Data stores must maintain version history to support recovery from accidental deletion or corruption

Control_Statement: Ensure uniform policy-based access control is enforced
Control_Description: Access to data resources must use centralized policy-based controls instead of per-object permissions

Control_Statement: Ensure data in transit is encrypted
Control_Description: All managed services must enforce encrypted connections for client communication

Control_Statement: Ensure automated backup and recovery is configured
Control_Description: Critical data services must have automated backup schedules to meet recovery point objectives

Control_Statement: Ensure services are not exposed to the public internet
Control_Description: Managed services storing sensitive data must not be directly reachable from untrusted networks
Compute workloads must not operate under default or overprivileged platform identities

Control_Statement: Ensure privileged credentials are not persistent
Control_Description: Root or master account identities must not have long-lived access credentials

Control_Statement: Ensure credential rotation meets policy requirements
Control_Description: Service credentials must not exceed the maximum age defined by organizational policy
